title: JESUS, THESE EYES HAVE NEVER SEEN
stanzas: Jesus, these eyes have never seen that radiant form of Thine; The veil of sense hangs dark between Thy blessed face and mine
I see Thee not, I hear Thee not, Yet art Thou oft with me; and earth has ne'er so dear a spot As where I meet with Thee
Like some bright dream that comes unsought, when slumbers o'er me roll. Thine image ever fills my thought, And charms my ravished soul.
Yet though I have not seen, I still must rest in faith alone, I love Thee, Dearest Lord, and will, Unseen, but not unknown
